transcriber_notes: Rows: 400 as printed (one row per court or branch court; province sub-headings moved into the Province column).

Columns 'Category' = the italic sub-heading under which the court is printed (Branch High Courts / District Courts (n)); 'Branch of' = the district court under which a branch court is listed after 'Branch :' / 'Branches :'. 'Location' is printed only for some courts; per the printed note, other courts are at the towns whose names they bear.
District court lists printed in two (in Kwangtung three) side-by-side columns are transcribed left column first, then right column.
Kiangsu District Courts: 'Nanking' printed opposite 'Shoutu' in the Location column; count of names = 13, matching printed (13).

Kwangtung District Courts (27 ; Branches : 63): 27 district courts and 63 branch names counted — both reconcile. Two branches, 'Lienkiang' and 'Wuchwan', are printed under a separate 'Branches :' at the top of the right-hand column with no district court name above them (the name of their parent court appears to have been omitted); 'Branch of' left blank. If they are counted with the other branches the total of 63 reconciles.
Kwangsi District Courts (5 ; Branches : 12): 5 courts and 12 branches counted — reconciles.
Ninghsia District Courts (8 ; Branches : 2): 8 courts and 2 branches (listed under Hotung) — reconciles.

Other printed counts checked: Chekiang (32), Anhwei (8), Kiangsi (8), Hupeh (16), Hunan (9), Szechwan (7), Shantung (27), Shansi (7), Honan (10), Kansu (12) all match the number of names printed. Shensi, Fukien, Kweichow, Charhar, Suiyuan district courts are printed without a count.
Shantung District Courts: 'Linyin' as printed (Branch High Court Sixth is at 'Linyi'). Kwangsi branch 'Kweuhsien' as printed. Szechwan 'Yahan' as printed.
Kweichow Branch High Court 'Second': no location printed.
',,' (ditto) in the Location column kept as printed (Kiangsu Third Branch High Court = Shanghai; Chinghai Sihu District Court = Sining; Sinkiang District Court = Tihwa).
